component.name: Biltoo
component.summary: Classic image viewer with Gallery and free-form Workspace

description.p: Biltoo is a Qt 6 image viewer built around one canvas and three modes: classic single-image browsing, a session Gallery with packaged layouts, and a free-form Workspace for comparing and arranging multiple images.

Open files, folders, or common archives (zip, tar, 7z, rar). Sessions can be sorted, navigated with a thumbnail strip, and saved as portable project files. Workspace supports transform handles, crop, colour adjustments, a print page guide, and PNG/PDF export without overwriting sources.
Slideshow supports optional transitions (crossfade, fade through black, slide projector). Fullscreen hides chrome and restores it on exit.
Initial 0.1.0 feature set: Image / Gallery / Workspace, projects, export, slideshow transitions, archives.
